_shape: brand_slug -> { product key: category, or null }
_product_key: the last path segment of the product URL — the Shopify handle, the WooCommerce slug, the Bellroy path
_null_means: reviewed, and it really is not a bag — it stays rejected and stops heading the audit list
_categories: briefcase, camera-bag, daypack, duffel, hiking-pack, hip-pack, luggage, messenger, pouch, sling, tote, travel-backpack
_precedence: a category ruling admits the product outright: the not-a-bag rules get no vote, and category_source reads `override`
_stale: a ruling nothing matched this run is printed by normalize.py and listed at /internal/
